aesthetic: Warm Archive / Museum Exhibition / Digital Journal
core_principles: Timeless and Sacred: Avoid gamification or cold tech aesthetics. This is an heirloom.
Editorial Elegance: Treat text like a museum publication. High contrast, low saturation, generous spacing.
Organic Textures: Use grainy textures, warm lighting, and dust particle overlays to prevent flatness.
Introspective Action: Long-form text and voice inputs should feel deeply focused, free of distraction.

font_families.utility: IBM Plex Mono (For stats, timestamps, and data)

rules: Never use Inter or standard system sans for headings.
Headings should primarily be left-aligned unless acting as a central section divider.
Always set hover colors explicitly (e.g., hover:text-white).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale 2-3x larger than average).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use Mode B (Control Room Grid) for Dashboard with gap-6. Keep cards stretched fully to match neighbors.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

components.cards: Flat background (#1C1A18) with a 1px subtle border (#36322E). No heavy drop shadows. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border shifts to #D4A373 at 50% opacity.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4A373] text-[#121110] hover:bg-[#E5B98E] font-medium tracking-wide px-6 py-3 rounded-sm transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#36322E] text-[#F2EFE9] hover:border-[#D4A373] hover:text-[#D4A373] transition-colors rounded-sm px-6 py-3

components.inputs: Shadcn inputs heavily customized. bg-[#121110] border border-[#36322E] text-[#F2EFE9] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4A373] focus:border-[#D4A373] rounded-sm.
components.dialogs: Solid background (#1C1A18). Do not use blur/glassmorphism for modals here, maintain the solid archival feel.
components.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

motion.transitions: Subtle and slow. transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion.page_load: Fade in with a very slight upward motion (framer-motion, y: 10 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.8s).
motion.hover: Focus on color shifts and crisp 1px borders rather than shadow expansion.

page_guidance.Landing: Hero section featuring 'dust particles floating warm light' image. Deep espresso background. Large Serif heading. A feeling of discovering an ancient, sacred space. No playful animations.
page_guidance.Auth: Minimalist high contrast. Left side: beautiful dark academia library image. Right side: Login/Signup form with journal entry motif.
page_guidance.Dashboard: Archive overview. Grid of stats (life captured, stories told) using IBM Plex Mono for numbers. A visual 'progress' artifact that feels like a life unfolding. Use 'Grid Borders' technical look for dense data.
page_guidance.Interviewer Chat: Avoid chat bubbles. Display as an elegant editorial Q&A script. AI questions are bold Serif. User answers are standard Sans text or voice recordings. Calm, left-aligned layout.
page_guidance.Voice Journal: Full screen immersive focus. Ambient dark background (#121110). A very subtle glowing wave visualizer in the accent color (#D4A373). Minimal distractions.
page_guidance.Memories_Stories_Library: Masonry layout of captured memories. Images have max black/40 overlay. Timestamps in utility mono font.
page_guidance.Import_Social_Data: Structured, functional layout. 'Retro-futuristic Terminal' feeling mixed with Archive. Monospace fonts for sync logs. Progress bars in accent color.
page_guidance.Talk_to_Twin_Chat: Similar to Interviewer Chat but designed for the Heirs. Intimate typography. Feels like a sacred communication channel.
page_guidance.Heirs_Management: Strictly functional. Shadcn table component customized for dark mode. Clean, authoritative layout to assign access.
page_guidance.Settings: Standard Shadcn UI forms. Grouped thoughtfully with 1px bottom borders separating sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement designs for Javascript (.js) files, avoiding TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure the application strictly uses the customized dark mode palette. Do not fall back to default Tailwind slate/gray colors.
Use framer-motion for page load fading, but keep interactions minimal to maintain the 'heirloom' tone.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, forms, nav links, and critical text outputs.
For the Interviewer and Twin chats, build a custom editorial layout instead of generic message bubbles.
Rely exclusively on the media URLs provided here for image backgrounds.
Use standard Tailwind HTML elements for layout structure. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions like forms, dialogs, and tables.
